verdict_vs_current.quote: That is about a 15.6% four-year premium, or approximately $82,000 more per year averaged across four years.

recommendation.quote: Financially, Google has now turned this from a merely fair offer into a compelling four-year package. Assuming you’re reasonably positive about the role, manager, and team, I would take it.

refresh_valued_at.quote: Because the recruiter explicitly said refreshes are not guaranteed, continue valuing them at zero when making the decision.

level_claim.quote: That is a legitimate switching premium—not an enormous one, but sufficient for a lateral move between strong companies.

walkaway_tied_to.quote: I would not walk away over compensation at this point; I would decline only because I materially preferred the actual job at Meta.

missing_info_requested: Exact vesting schedule and first vest date
Whether your first bonus is prorated
Sign-on repayment terms and clawback language

ask_focus.quote: Should you negotiate again? No—not for more compensation.

year1_vs_recurring.quote: You retain a modest recurring compensation increase after the sign-on year.

forfeiture_as_loss.quote: The forfeited Meta equity has been fully matched on a pretax dollar-for-dollar basis.
